Daily AI news + real skills

caption:
Swipe through all 5 before you send a single cold email. Every prompt here works tonight with a client list you already have. 💰

Prompt 1 finds which past clients are statistically ready to buy again based on purchase history and spend, Prompt 2 writes a personalized upsell email from your client's own story in 30 seconds, Prompt 3 turns one real client result into a pitch for five similar clients, Prompt 4 builds a referral ask so specific the client forwards it to someone tonight, Prompt 5 writes the check-in that reopens relationships that went quiet without asking for money

The biggest untapped revenue for most service businesses is already sitting in their own inbox. AI does not find new customers. It makes sure you never forget to ask the right existing ones at the right time. Running a business? DM us "AI" and we will show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: Bain and Company (repeat customer spend and acquisition cost research), Anthropic

hook_sharpen.why: [2] hits like an accusation that wakes you up at 2am—'YOU'RE IGNORING' lands harder than passive observations, and the specific 67% + action verb 'go get' makes you want to prove it works. [1] is solid with the same stat but reads like advice, not a call to stop scrolling.
